item: D-12-xt (quant ruling on PR #514; sr-v3 card work item D-12-xt)

geometry.floor: 1.5 x median 1m TR of the 1440 minutes up to the decision

never_read: any dense-label store value (labels computed here) or sr-v3 / H-102 outcome

candidates.name: control_grid
candidates.how: H < 1 d: every (H/tf)-th tf-bar close of each NY-17:00 session day; H >= 1 d: the first close of every ceil(H/1 d)-th business session day (1w: every ceil(H/1 w)-th epoch week); same times on every instrument

candidates.name: box_break_close
candidates.labelled_with: every xt-v1 geometry; greedy non-overlap at hold H per instrument

candidates.name: sweep_absorb
candidates.labelled_with: every xt-v1 geometry; greedy non-overlap at hold H per instrument

candidates.name: session_range_break
candidates.labelled_with: every xt-v1 geometry; greedy non-overlap at hold H per instrument

binds_with.rule: rho_u_day, rho_u_inst_day_mean and rho_u_inst_vs_gold_day_mean bind at max(D-12 recorded, re-run) per class x bucket; tau_a / lambda_a are the re-run value only (quant ruling on #514)

stated_deviations: rows are the factory's usable rows: label window (decision month .. horizon end) A / A-consistent on the D-1 served tiers (gold graded too); D-12 used gold unfiltered and the r11-v2.1 HistData tiers per minute
HistData has no ask: ask = bid (as the dense labels); XAG and FX bps costs are D-12's assumptions
rho_x is the D-12 file's (`rho_x_from`; label-blind features; the exit geometry does not enter)
hold = H puts 1m alone in le60m and 5m alone in 1h-4h; gt4h holds 8 h .. 20 d

bootstrap.block: ISO week of the NY-17:00 session day, all instruments jointly

not_measurable.crosses: EURAUD, EURGBP, GBPAUD: tier B/C only

rho_x_from.note: D-12a rho_x, read from this file

binding_by_tf.rule: quant ruling 1 on #525 (bind per tf): rho_u,inst(tf) = max(D-12 binding of the tf's bucket, the cumulative max of the re-run per-tf value over holds <= this tf), the same for the vs-gold level; rho_u,day(tf) = max(D-12 bucket value, re-run at the tf), undefined for H >= 1 d (design effect 1); tau_a(tf) = the re-run at the tf only
